name: core
description: Small owned ontology: five conditions with symptoms, treatments and side effects, joined to a shared participation subgraph of procedures, requirements, barriers and mitigating resources.

nodes.name: you must attend the site in person
the appointment takes most of a day
you must record something every day
you must read and complete forms yourself
you have no reliable way to get to the site
your work pattern clashes with appointment times
travel and time off work cost money you do not have
there is nobody at home to help you
keeping to a treatment routine is already hard for you
travelling and waiting are physically hard
forms and instructions are hard to follow
other conditions compete for the same appointments
the site is a long journey away
your medication routine is already complicated
app-based tasks are difficult for you
your journey depends on public transport running
a study buddy or research nurse contact
reminder calls from the research nurse
